findings.title: Reject optional presence on the selected status field
findings.observed: Changing only the migration's status: TodoStatus to status: TodoStatus optional parses cleanly and leaves exactly TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_BINDING_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, with no TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_SELECTOR_INVALID. AST confirms Todo.status.optional=true. Removing the descriptor leaves zero analysis diagnostics, so another invalid-source diagnostic does not mask the omission.
findings.cause: The status/enum branch checks declared_type.nullable, secret and arguments but omits status.optional. Optional presence belongs to the containing shape and is not inherited through field value-type refinements (docs/type-system.md:578). delivery_scalar and required-owner branches already inspect field.optional separately. An omittable status shape therefore passes this necessary selector's exact enum-field check.
findings.impact: Incomplete necessary selector diagnostic coverage, not an execution or authority escape: the unconditional delivery guard still prevents checked job publication/export/lowering. Do not characterize the selector prerequisites as accepted while this shape slips through.
findings.required_correction: Add status.optional to the status rejection conditions (or an equivalent explicit required-presence check), and a grounded mutation negative using status: TodoStatus optional. Keep the unconditional unsupported-binding guard and all ordinary policies unchanged. This is routine expression of the existing closed status contract, not a new business choice.
acceptance: Unmodified grounded migration fixture retains exactly TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_BINDING_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Changing only Todo.status to TodoStatus optional emits TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_SELECTOR_INVALID plus TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_BINDING_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, no delivery checked row, and approval derivation remains refused.
Existing effective nullable status negative, due/sent/owner optional negatives and nominal schedule tests stay passing.
No typed-binding model, target/profile/export authority introduced.
